#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized, self-contained single-file release binary and places it at ./app.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"

export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1
export DOTNET_NOLOGO=1

out_dir="$(pwd)/.build/publish"
rm -rf "$out_dir"

dotnet publish src/WordFreq.csproj \
  --configuration Release \
  --output "$out_dir" \
  -p:DebugType=none \
  -p:DebugSymbols=false \
  --runtime "$(dotnet --info | awk '/RID:/ {print $2; exit}')" \
  --nologo

cp "$out_dir/app" ./app
chmod +x ./app

<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
    <TargetFramework>net11.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <AssemblyName>app</AssemblyName>
    <RootNamespace>WordFreq</RootNamespace>
    <InvariantGlobalization>true</InvariantGlobalization>
    <!-- Native AOT is not used: it requires a full Xcode toolchain to link on macOS. -->
    <PublishSingleFile>true</PublishSingleFile>
    <SelfContained>true</SelfContained>
    <PublishTrimmed>true</PublishTrimmed>
    <IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract>true</IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract>
    <PublishReadyToRun>true</PublishReadyToRun>
    <TieredPGO>true</TieredPGO>
    <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
  </PropertyGroup>

</Project>
